verdict.rationale: An HRIS/payroll sync is a fair capability to ask of a cap table platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no Gusto, Rippling or other HRIS integration. Stakeholders come in through Excel or Carta imports, and terminations are entered by hand via Actions → Terminate Stakeholder, which is a manual workflow rather than an automated sync.

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically
